d: During interaction with India's Asian Para Games 2026 contingent, PM Modi says, "Back in 2014, when the nation embarked on the journey toward ambitious goals, the circumstances were entirely different. Most parents were hesitant—even afraid—to encourage their children to pursue sports. There was a crumbling infrastructure, a scarcity of resources, a lack of support, and an absence of transparency. People used to say that this system was beyond repair. They had simply resigned themselves to the belief that things would always remain this way. But just as you refused to give up in the face…
